title: BigP3BCI Study N — 9x8 dry/wet electrode comparison (8 ALS subjects)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 8 ALS patients participating in a P300-based brain-computer interface speller study, comparing 9x8 dry and wet electrode configurations. Subjects completed 2 sessions each with visual stimulus presentation paradigms designed to detect target and non-target events. The data were acquired at 256 Hz using a g.USBamp amplifier with 16 channels in a standard 10-20 montage and represent a subset of the larger BigP3BCI dataset.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage. The study employed a P300 paradigm with visual stimulus presentation in a 9x8 character grid speller configuration. Line frequency was 60 Hz. Subjects completed 2 sessions with target and non-target event classifications. HED 8.4.0 event annotations were applied to classify sensory and experimental stimulus events.
